Plugin.d: In Claude Code, an installable package that bundles skills, subagents, hooks, MCP servers and other extensions, so a whole team can get the same setup in one step.

Plugin marketplace.d: A catalogue of Claude Code plugins, usually a Git repository with a .claude-plugin/marketplace.json file. Teams add a marketplace once, then install plugins from it by name.

Print mode.d: Running Claude Code non-interactively with claude -p: it answers one prompt and exits, which makes it usable in scripts and CI pipelines. Also called headless mode.

Continuous integration.d: Automatically building and testing software every time code changes (or on a schedule), using services such as GitHub Actions. Usually shortened to CI.

Flaky test.d: A test that sometimes passes and sometimes fails without any change to the code, usually because of timing, shared state or an unreliable environment.

Regression testing.d: Re-running tests after a change to check that things that used to work still work.
